title: 第16章 爆发第17章 老虎
content_zh:
裁判和陈冲的眼神对视了一下，顿时挑了挑眉，往后退去。
被陈冲完全无视的张耀脸皮一僵，神情瞬间就沉了下去。
他一是觉得面上挂不住，毕竟他一向喜欢别人吹捧，喜欢擂台的中央；
二来，他感觉陈冲和李晓光有些不一样。
说不上来是表现还是气质，但心中莫名升起淡淡的危险感觉，他决定抢先出手。他的心思比长相细腻，今晚是他的关键时刻，他不容许意外发生。
“装你妈呢！我倒要看看你的头跟刚刚那个哪个更硬！”
裁判还没完全退到场边，张耀就啐了一口，两个大踏步冲了过来，硕大的拳头紧紧收拢，一记炮拳像攻城锤一般砸了过来！
离得近的观众一下屏住了呼吸。
张耀的态度和展现的实力显然跟刚刚不同了，在前排的他们甚至都紧张起来，下意识往后仰身，仿佛那一拳能隔空打到自己。
……
高处的包厢旁。
黑铁塔般的于峰看着拳台上的暖场拳手，眉头紧紧皱起。
不是交代过了吗？他怎么会上场？
现在这个情形去跟张耀打，他哪里打得过？
于峰心中变得十分沉重。
在他眼里，张耀的水平和天赋都不值一提；
如果再给陈冲几个月训练时间，这个靠姐姐卖肉才能耀武扬威的拳手连给他提鞋都不配。
但现在不行，现在的陈冲训练的时间太短了，积累根本比不上对手。
特别是刚刚发生了意外情况，两边都已上头，不会留手，那陈冲恐怕很难活着走下来，被废了抬下来都是侥幸。
明显是被怒火冲昏了头脑。

于峰心里很遗憾。
但一个控制不了情绪的拳手就算天赋再好，早晚会有这样的教训，他的教训来得格外早一点而已……或许不是在这里的话，自己还有机会纠正他，可惜的是没有或许。
于峰已经有些出神，在他看到张耀的认真之后就判断了比赛的结局。他少见的有些不想看下一幕的发生。
然而一声闷响之后，整座酒吧都安静了一下。
于峰抬头，然后愣住。
包厢里。
周虎大声吼叫，女人则已经瘫软在窗台上，浑身湿透，双眼迷离。
实话说，她能承受住周虎这等级的格斗者，的确是天赋异禀，正常男人绝不会是她的对手。
然而关键时刻，周虎突然停住了。
女人有些茫然，下意识抬起头，模糊的视野看到弟弟又在和人打擂，拳头已经打到了敌人身上。
看来又是一场爽快的胜利，女人挺了挺胸，露出自豪的笑容。
……
张耀拿出全力的炮拳轰到近前，他不知道陈冲为什么不闪不避，甚至没有动作，但他不会因此心生犹豫，而是狠狠将拳头捶向了陈冲的胸口。
砰！
一声闷响，盖过整座酒吧的喧嚣。
炮拳撞到了一只手掌，停下。
那是陈冲的左手。
他只是简简单单的抬起左手，就挡住了张耀的重拳。
content_en:
The referee and Chen Chong looked at each other, raised their eyebrows, and stepped back.
Zhang Yao, who was completely ignored by Chen Chong, stiffened and his expression suddenly darkened.
Firstly, he felt that he could not keep up his reputation, after all, he always liked others to praise him and liked being in the center of the ring;
Secondly, he felt that Chen Chong and Li Xiaoguang were somewhat different.
He couldn't tell whether it was his performance or his temperament, but a faint feeling of danger arose in his heart for no reason, and he decided to take action first. His mind is more delicate than his appearance. Tonight is his critical moment and he will not allow accidents to happen.
"You're pretending to be your mother! I want to see which one is harder, your head or the one just now!"
Before the referee even retreated to the sidelines, Zhang Yao spat, rushed over with two long strides, tightly closed his huge fists, and struck with a cannon punch like a battering ram!
The spectators who were close to him held their breath.
Zhang Yao's attitude and strength were obviously different from before. They in the front row even became nervous and leaned back subconsciously, as if the punch could hit them from the air.
…
Next to the high box.
Yu Feng, who looked like a black iron tower, frowned tightly as he looked at the warm-up boxers on the ring.
Didn’t you explain it before? How did he get on the field?
If you were to fight Zhang Yao in this situation, how could he beat him?
Yu Feng's heart became very heavy.
In his eyes, Zhang Yao's level and talent are not worth mentioning;
If Chen Chong was given a few more months to train, this boxer who relied on his sister to sell meat to show off his power would not even be worthy of carrying his shoes.
But it doesn't work now. Chen Chong's training time is too short now, and his accumulation is simply not as good as his opponent's.
Especially since an unexpected situation had just occurred, both sides were on top and would not hold back. It would be difficult for Chen Chong to come down alive. It would be a fluke if he was crippled and carried down.
He was obviously blinded by anger.
Yu Feng felt very sorry.
But a boxer who can't control his emotions, no matter how talented he is, will learn such a lesson sooner or later. His lesson just came a little earlier... Maybe if he hadn't been here, he would have had the chance to correct him, but unfortunately there was no chance.
Yu Feng was already in a trance. After he saw Zhang Yao's seriousness, he judged the outcome of the game. It was rare that he didn't want to see what happened next.
However, after a muffled sound, the whole bar fell silent.
Yu Feng raised his head, then froze.
In the box.
Zhou Hu roared loudly, while the woman was already slumped on the window sill, soaked all over and her eyes were blurred.
To be honest, she was indeed gifted for being able to withstand a fighter of Zhou Hu's level. Normal men would never be her match.
However, at the critical moment, Zhou Hu suddenly stopped.
The woman was a little confused. She raised her head subconsciously and saw her brother fighting with someone again through her blurred vision. Her fist had already hit the enemy.
It seemed like another refreshing victory. The woman straightened her chest and smiled proudly.
…
Zhang Yao used all his strength to blast forward with his cannon fist. He didn't know why Chen Chong didn't dodge or even made any move, but he would not hesitate because of this and instead punched Chen Chong's chest hard.
Bang!
A muffled sound drowned out the din of the entire bar.
Cannon Fist hit a palm and stopped.
That is Chen Chong's left hand.
He simply raised his left hand and blocked Zhang Yao's heavy punch.
